A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have designed, developed and evaluated a novel approach to boost the ground-truth collection process, which can be used to label application traffic with minimal privacy concerns and without requiring any payloaded data to exist in the first place.
we have developed and deployed an application-aware traffic classification system, GTVS, to automatically collect and classify application traffic traces.
we propose GTVS, a novel approach to automatically generate application-labeled ground-truth traces from non-payload data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to obtain application ground-truth information with a high degree of accuracy from non-payload data.

, in the absence of payloaded data and with a limited set of application signatures, it is possible to obtain ground-truth application labels for a large fraction of the traffic in a network by leveraging the information in the DNS queries.

, by using a combination of traffic analysis, machine learning, and crowdsourcing, we can significantly boost the amount of application ground-truth information that is available to the research community.
